name: Device
description: Servers, network gear, computers, printers and anything else with a network or serial number. The record's name is the device's name (usually its hostname).

fields.label: Status
fields.help: Unreviewed: found by a sync, waiting for a person. Ignored: not ours to track (left out of counts).

fields.label: Product number
fields.help: The maker's product number (SKU), e.g. A3RF5UA#ABA. HP's warranty lookup needs it.

fields.label: Class
fields.help: Leave blank to classify by model (Assets, Computer classes). Set it when this computer is the exception.

fields.label: OS notes
fields.help: Version details, licensing or anything else about the operating system.

fields.label: Processor
fields.help: e.g. Intel Core i5-10500T. Checked against each OS's processor list (OS readiness).

fields.label: Storage (GB)
fields.help: Total of its fixed drives.

fields.label: TPM
fields.help: The TPM's version, e.g. 2.0, or None.

fields.label: Rack position
fields.help: e.g. MDF rack 2, U14

fields.label: In service since (estimate)
fields.help: When it was probably first used, for a computer with no purchase or warranty date: from when it joined the domain, its BIOS date or an invoice. Budget counts its age from this, marked as an estimate.

fields.label: Last seen on the network
fields.help: The week an inventory scan last found it (from a sync).

fields.label: Last signed in (AD)
fields.help: When its computer account last signed in to the domain (accurate to about two weeks).

fields.label: Joined the domain
fields.help: When its current computer account was created: a reimage or rename that rejoins makes it later.

fields.label: AD location
fields.help: Where its computer account is in AD (OU path).

fields.label: Status in AD
fields.help: What its account says: disabled or in Purge is Retired, Shelf Stock is Spare. Kept in step with Status both ways.

fields.label: Home OU (AD)
fields.help: Where its account goes back to when it's made Active again.

fields.label: Last seen (Sophos)
fields.help: When the Sophos agent on it last reported to Sophos Central, from anywhere (off the network too). Counts as seen, like a scan.

fields.label: Protection (Sophos)
fields.help: Sophos Central's overall health for it.

fields.label: Protection problems (Sophos)
fields.help: What Sophos says is wrong: threats, services stopped, tamper protection off.

fields.label: Last user (Sophos)
fields.help: Who last signed in to it, as Sophos saw it.

fields.label: IP address (Sophos)
fields.help: Its IPv4 addresses when Sophos last saw it.

name: Monitor
description: Displays and other peripherals counted in the device budget. The record's name is the model and serial number.

name: SSL certificate
description: TLS certificates. The record's name is the main host name on the certificate. Never store private keys here.

fields.label: Alternative names
fields.help: Other host names on the certificate, one per line.

fields.label: How it's renewed
fields.help: e.g. Certify the Web, automatic

name: Contact
description: People to reach: staff, vendor contacts, support lines. The record's name is the person's name.

name: Location
description: Sites and buildings. The record's name is the site's name.

name: Domain
description: Registered domain names. The record's name is the domain.

name: IP address
description: IP addresses and what uses them. The record's name is the address.
